references.text: The Abarim Mountains are mentioned where Moses is told to go up the mountain to see the land that the children of Israel will receive.
Moses is commanded to go up Mount Nebo in the Abarim Mountains, the same place mentioned in this travel account.
Mount Nebo is the place where Moses went up from the plains of Moab to see the promised land before he died.
The place name Beth-Diblathaim in Jeremiah may be linked to Almon-Diblathaim, which was the starting point for the journey to the Abarim Mountains.
Diblah is mentioned in Ezekiel as a geographical reference in the same area.
